restaurantName: mille sens - les goûts du monde
bio: At this pleasantly lively, modern restaurant on the first floor of the Schweizerhof Passage near the train station, chef Domingo S. Domingo takes you on a culinary journey around the world, also drawing on his Australian and Filipino roots. At lunchtime, options include a small set menu (Business Lunch) and the Quicktray comprising four dishes on one plate. In the evening, guests can choose from the Domingo Pur Menu Surprise and Tavolata – also available in a large portion to share. The small selection of bowls is available at both mealtimes....
